name: footfall
title: Footfall — AI Developer Tool Adoption Analytics
description: Read-only MCP server providing empirical adoption analytics for AI developer tools (agent frameworks, SDKs, vector databases, MCP servers). Compares production package installs against social bookmarks.

tools.name: footfall_compare
tools.description: Compare 2 to 6 tools side-by-side on adoption velocity, attention, and divergence.

tools.name: footfall_trend
tools.description: Retrieve weekly time-series history of downloads and stars for a single tool.

tools.name: footfall_find_rising
tools.description: Find accelerating AI tools filtered by category and lifecycle phase.
